#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    std::string user_input;
    std::getline(std::cin, user_input);

    // Replace 'dot' with '.' in the middle of the string
    if (user_input.length() > 2) {
        user_input[0] = user_input[0]; // first character remains
        // Replace 'dot' with '.' in the middle
        std::string middle_part = user_input.substr(1, user_input.length() - 2);
        size_t pos = 0;
        while ((pos = middle_part.find("dot")) != std::string::npos) {
            middle_part.replace(pos, 3, ".");
        }
        // Replace 'at' with '@' once
        size_t at_pos = middle_part.find("at");
        if (at_pos != std::string::npos) {
            middle_part.replace(at_pos, 2, "@");
        }
        // Reconstruct the string
        user_input = user_input[0] + middle_part + user_input.back();
    }

    std::cout << user_input << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
